title: Trash: deleted notes for 30 days, and Restore undoes the delete
steps: Open Links to deleted notes: each link says In Trash · Restore.
Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K), type trash and press Enter: two notes Claude deleted, each with 30 days left. Select one with j/k, press Enter to look inside, and r to restore it, with its history.
Open any note and type :trash (or use its tab's menu, Move this note to Trash): it's in Trash, deleted by you, and the notice's Undo brings it back.
Press ⌘K, type scratch, and tap the Trash chip: notes in Trash are found only with is:trashed.
On a phone, open Trash and swipe a row right: it goes green and restores.
